About The Role:
Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) refers to using software engineering methods to manage systems, solve problems, and achieve operational automation to reduce trivial tasks and improve service availability. Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
Manage the operational work of NetEase Interactive Entertainment services, such as Eggy Party, Marvel Rivals, UU Accelerator, Ace Racer, and other online services, as well as internal research projects.
Design and select basic runtime environments (including servers, virtualization, cloud services, networks, databases, etc.) for game servers based on different games' service architecture, performance requirements, and business conditions, providing high-quality and efficient operational services at controllable costs.
Establish and monitor various operational metrics and customize data analysis standards.
Collaborate with product departments to identify issues, optimize technical architecture, and enhance user experience based on game and infrastructure conditions.
Participate in in-depth research on cutting-edge open-source software, virtualization, databases, and web services, and develop technical solutions for business implementation.
Job Requirements:
Bachelor's degree or above, majors in computer science, networking, communications, automation, or related fields are preferred.
Familiar with the Linux operating system; knowledgeable about computer network architectures and common network protocols such as TCP/IP and HTTP.
Proficient in at least one programming language, including but not limited to C/C++, Shell, Python, Golang, Rust, or Java.
Passionate about open-source; experience or knowledge in open-source software such as Linux, Nginx, MySQL, K8S, and Istio is preferred.
Strong logical thinking, communication, and learning abilities; adept at research and problem-solving.
Skilled at teamwork, with a strong sense of collective honor, responsibility, and service awareness.
Open to trying new things, with excellent problem-solving skills and strong technical sensitivity; experience in contributing to open-source communities is a plus.
Keen on AI/LLM trends, with awareness and hands-on experience applying AI to operations preferred (e.g., AIOps analysis, automated script generation, root-cause analysis); AIOps project experience or proven AI tool results is a plus.
Native or near-native proficiency in Chinese is required for this role as some working partners and stakeholders are from China.

Role Overview
The Commercial Strategy Manager, Merchant leads the design, optimization, and implementation of Rocket Now’s merchant-facing commercial engine. Positioned at the intersection of Business Operations (BizOps), Commercial Strategy, and Process Engineering, you will build the scalable workflows to ensure smooth workflows across all acquisition channels to set our SME and B2B teams up for success.

You will own the end-to-end commercial operational lifecycle—from segmenting our merchant base (B2B, Mid-Market, SMEs) and building custom value propositions to re-engineering sales workflows, streamlining deal approvals, and launching new go-to-market processes. Define and execute distinct commercial strategies for key merchant segments.
Segment Growth Mechanics:
Analyze merchant LTV, acquisition costs, and churn drivers across each tier to optimize target allocation and yield by segment.
Tailored Value Propositions:
Custom-fit Rocket Now’s ROI narratives and pitch architectures to match the operational models and financial priorities of different merchant categories.
Process Optimization & Commercial Engineering
Commercial Workflow Redesign:
Audit and streamline the entire merchant lifecycle—from lead routing, contract negotiation, and deal-desk approvals to onboarding and account handoffs.
Friction & Bottleneck Elimination:
Analyze frontline execution metrics using data diagnostics to remove operational drag, reduce sales cycle times, and increase partner onboarding velocity.
Governance:
Establish clear policies & guidelines across the business to create clarity for sales partners and local operations teams.
Implementation & Change Management
Process Rollout Execution:
Design, test, and roll out scalable commercial frameworks, SOPs, and pitch tools across the merchant organization, ensuring high adoption through structured enablement.
System Integration:
Partner with Sales Ops and Product to embed optimized commercial rules and automated workflows
Cross-Functional Orchestration:
Align Sales, Marketing, Legal, Finance, and Product teams around new commercial rollouts and operational standards.
Analytics, Monitoring & Scalability
Process Diagnostics via SQL:
Write SQL queries to monitor process yield, deal conversion rates, SLA compliance, and segment performance.
Automated Tracking Dashboards:
Build automated BI dashboards (e.g., Sheets, PowerBI, Superset) to provide executive leadership real-time visibility into segment performance, deal velocity, and operational health.

4+ years in strategy, business operations, sales operations, or management consulting, with a focus on process redesign and commercial execution.
Process Strategy:
Demonstrated ability to audit complex workflows, build segment-differentiated go-to-market frameworks, and lead multi-stakeholder rollouts.

Strong proficiency in SQL and spreadsheet modeling to quantify process friction, analyze datasets, and model segment performance independently.

Strong execution and leadership skills, with a track record of driving process adoption across sales or account management teams.

Business-level English and Japanese to ensure smooth communication with local partners.
Preferred
Background in three-sided marketplaces, e-commerce, or food delivery.

Streamlined Execution:
Measurable reduction in contract turnaround times and accelerated time-to-onboard for new merchant locations.
Segment Precision:
Differentiated commercial strategies that yield higher deal conversion and predictable revenue growth across segments.
High Adoption:
Seamless implementation and frontline compliance with new commercial SOPs, approval matrix rules, and pitch toolkits.
Scalable Operations:
Shifting the commercial org from ad-hoc, manual decision-making to automated, standardized, and data-backed workflows.

Role Overview
The Detection Engineering (DE) team within Coupang’s Digital Trust organization designs and operates end-to-end security threat detection and response automation systems. Our mission is to build an AI-powered Security Operations Center (AI-SOC) that enables faster, more accurate, and scalable security operations through intelligent automation. Working under a Detection-as-Code philosophy, we manage the entire detection lifecycle, including threat scenario development, log collection, detection engineering, automated response orchestration, and AI-driven threat analysis.
As part of the Automation Engineering pillar, this role is responsible for designing, developing, and operating automated workflows that analyze, investigate, and respond to security threats at scale. The team builds and maintains integrations across a broad range of security platforms, develops AI Agent and LLM-based analysis capabilities for automated triage and investigation, and ensures the reliability, scalability, and operational excellence of critical security automation systems in production. This position offers the opportunity to shape the future of AI-driven security operations by building the technologies that power Coupang’s next-generation AI-SOC platform.

Design and develop normalization, enrichment, and automated triage workflows to analyze and process security detection events at scale.
Design, develop, and operate SOAR workflows that streamline and automate security operations processes.
Build and maintain integrations with security platforms and external services, including SIEM, EDR, CTI, ticketing systems, and SaaS/API-based solutions.
Develop and enhance the AI-SOC framework by creating LLM-based triage and analysis logic, confidence scoring mechanisms, and automated response orchestration capabilities.
Drive operational excellence by managing incident response for SOAR and automation systems, operating logging and monitoring infrastructure, and improving system reliability.
Design and implement automated response scenarios based on detection use cases while collaborating closely with SOC and Incident Response teams.
Analyze and optimize automation workflows by identifying performance bottlenecks and driving continuous improvements in efficiency, scalability, and effectiveness.

5+ years of professional software engineering experience with strong proficiency in Python development, including modular design, code quality, exception handling, and testing
Experience designing, implementing, and improving security event processing, detection, and response workflows through software engineering
Hands-on experience with security technologies such as SIEM, EDR, SOAR, and CTI platforms, including customization, integration, and operational support
Experience developing integrations using RESTful APIs, Webhooks, and JSON-based data processing
Experience designing, building, and operating systems in cloud environments, preferably AWS
Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve complex system incidents
Experience with Git-based software development workflows and CI/CD pipeline practices

Experience designing, developing, or operating AI-SOC platforms or LLM-powered security automation solutions
Experience building applications using LLM agent and workflow frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar technologies
Experience operating large-scale SOAR or workflow automation platforms with multiple production automation workflows
Experience working with Kubernetes and EKS environments in production
Experience extending or developing custom capabilities for security automation platforms
Strong understanding of SIEM detection logic and security event lifecycle management
Experience operating log processing pipelines, message queues, and related distributed infrastructure
Experience building security operations dashboards and analytics solutions using data visualization tools
